# Marubozu

> The next generation trading hub. Profit Follows Discipline.

## What is Marubozu?

Marubozu is a web platform for active traders who want to journal their trades, track performance, manage wallet allocations across exchanges, and stay macro-aware — all in one place.

## Core Features

- **Trade Journal**: Rich-text journal with checklist, mood tracking, timeframe tags, and multi-execution support (entries, scale-ins, partial take profits). A trade can be cloned as the starting point for a new one.
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Win rate, profit factor, equity curve, drawdown, average R:R. Mood and checklist completion are logged in the journal for every trade.
- **Behavioral Analytics** *(coming soon)*: Mood, checklist completion and macro environment correlated with trade results.
- **Multi-Exchange Wallet**: Two wallet types supported. **Crypto exchange wallets** connect to Binance, KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC or Bitunix — these exchanges are also used for pair retrieval. **Virtual wallets** can represent funds held on any platform: traditional brokers (Trade Republic, XTB, etc.), banks, or any other account. For virtual wallets, pair data is sourced from Tiingo, Metal Sentinel, ExchangeRate-API, FRED and other providers depending on asset class. Marubozu is a tracker — no order execution is possible from within the platform.
- **Macro Dashboard**: Economic cycle detection, intermarket correlations, and money flow by asset class.
- **Macro Context in the Journal** *(Pro)*: Each trade's journal has a Macro context card: economic cycle phase at open and close; how the dollar index, SPY, QQQ, gold, oil and the 2- and 10-year Treasury yields moved from open to close; high-impact events within ±3 days of opening. Details on demand: 1D/1W/1M changes, macro indicators (counted only once published, with a conservative publication delay) and sources. Traders can record their own macro read (Risk-on / Neutral / Risk-off) with a short note; a read written after the close is flagged. The context is reconstructed from the trade dates, so it also works on past trades (with less data before 2026).
- **Personal Library & Docs**: Research, macro thesis, and past studies organized in folders; quick notes always one click away.
- **Custom Checklists**: Pre-trade checklists applied to every trade to enforce discipline under pressure.
- **Discipline & Streaks** *(coming soon)*: Daily journaling streaks and rule compliance tracking.
- **Economic Calendar**: Macro events with release times, market sessions, market holidays, personal events, and your trades with daily PnL. Pro adds a signal on trades opened within ±2 hours of CPI, NFP or an FOMC decision.
- **AI Journal Assistant** *(coming soon)*: Answers questions from your own trading history.
- **TradingView alert bridge** *(coming soon)*: TradingView alerts logged as notes in your journal, so you can review the setups you saw and how you traded them.

## Pricing

Marubozu is currently in beta. Join the waitlist at https://marubozu.trade/#waitlist.

- **Free trial**: 7 days, no credit card required.
- **Founding Members**: everyone who joins and confirms the waitlist while the founding window is open (before public launch) can subscribe to Pro at a founding price of €14/month or €134/year, fixed for life, including future Pro features. Founding status concerns the price and is kept after cancelling; access to Pro requires an active subscription. Founding status is personal and non-transferable.
- **Standard plans after launch**: Core €14/month or €134/year; Pro €24/month or €230/year.
  - **Core**: journal, notes & documents with up to 3 images each (a trade journal counts as one item, all sections together).
  - **Pro**: unlimited images in journal, notes & documents; macro context in the journal; calendar signal for trades opened near CPI, NFP or FOMC.

## Target Users

Active retail traders in crypto, forex, and equities — including traders using crypto exchanges (Binance, KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC, Bitunix) and traditional brokers (Trade Republic, XTB, etc.) — who want a unified system to track all positions, improve consistency, discipline, and edge over time. Marubozu is a tracker: no order execution is possible from within the platform.

## Technology

Web application (SaaS). Works in any modern browser. No installation required.

## URL

https://marubozu.trade/
